fields.text: NCIA is a joke! Boards say my flight is at Gate A1. I walked to A1 and it's empty. App says A12. Now I'm gonna miss my flight! #Fail #NCIA #Cleveland

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A handheld phone snapshot taken inside a terminal concourse, angled slightly upward. The foreground shows a passengerGate A12A1' on a metal sign, with a cracked, flickering departures monitor behind it. The monitor's rows are unreadable, glowing green and static-laced. The background is a busy terminal: passengers walking past, a luggage cart, a TSA agent at a checkpoint. The lighting is flat fluorescent, time of day is midday. The image has a slight flash glare and soft blur on the edges, as if taken in haste. Setting: inside an airport passenger terminal: check-in counters, rows of dark powered-off departure boards, overhead wayfinding signs seen as plain shapes, luggage carts, high ceilings, large windows
